Raw Meal Infeed & Negative Draft Induction (0m)
Pre-calcined meal induction from cyclone C5 with negative draft containment
Transfers 330 t/h pre-calcined meal from preheater cyclone C5 into the rotating kiln inlet under -3.82 mbar draft.
630 kW Drive Train & Girth Gear Power Transmission
VFD inverter torque control, helical speed reduction, and girth gear meshing
Converts 630 kW VFD electrical power through a triple-reduction helical gearbox and 19-tooth pinion into 3.80 RPM rotation.
3-Pier Roller Support & Station 2 Hydraulic Thrust Float
Hydrodynamic load sharing and hydraulic cylinder oscillating axial float ±20 mm
Supports 3,200 t kiln deadweight across 3 piers while Station 2 hydraulic cylinder cycles axial float over a 4.2h period.
Rotary Shell Clinkering & Infrared Thermal Scanner Mapping
High-temperature calcination and clinkering with 360° shell infrared line-scanner monitoring
Cascades raw meal through the 1,450 °C burning zone to sinter alite and belite clinker phases under constant optical shell monitoring.
Discharge Hood & Outlet Seal Forced Air Cooling (74m)
Clinker evacuation to grate cooler with negative hood draft and forced cooling fan
Discharges 1,400 °C clinker into the grate cooler while forced cooling fan protects lamella spring plates under negative hood draft.
Multi-Channel Primary Burner & Pulverized Coal Line (74m)
10.58 t/h pulverized coal dosing with axial/radial swirl air flame shaping
Injects 10.58 t/h pulverized coal with high-momentum primary air to sustain a 1,450 °C sintering flame core in the burning zone.
